messages.subject: Project Ironhold - credit approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Andrew,

Pleased to confirm that Northbank's credit committee has approved the restructuring on the agreed terms: the 12m super-senior facility, the extension of the senior facilities to December 2029, the reset covenants and the shareholder debt-for-equity. Grace Sato will run agency for the amended facilities. We're aligned on a 24 April effective date.

Richard Pemberton
Relationship Director, Northbank plc
